narrative.overview: Rove treats a personal closet as a working archive rather than a retail catalog. Crisp white product plates sit on a quiet cool-paper ground, while the sidebar and metadata behave like a compact studio filing system. The outfit builder becomes a softly lit blue styling table where garments can be moved into relation.
keyCharacteristics: High-resolution garment cutouts on clean white plates.
A narrow persistent navigation rail on desktop and a bottom dock on mobile.
Dense controls paired with generous space around the wardrobe grid.
One electric-blue accent with a pale blue composition surface.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Electric blue marks active choice or assisted work; it does not decorate passive content.

rules.name: The Image Leads Rule
rules.body: Type identifies and organizes garments; it never becomes more visually elaborate than the wardrobe itself.

rules.name: The Flat Archive Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces are separated by tone and rules; shadows indicate active handling or floating layers.

dos: Do let garment imagery carry the color and personality of closet views.
Do reserve electric blue for active choices, assisted work, and focus.
Do preserve the two-column mobile closet and persistent bottom navigation.
Do keep product cutouts centered with generous clear margin.
donts: Don't add decorative gradients, glass effects, or nested card shells.
Don't turn metadata into oversized dashboard metrics.
Don't use more than one saturated interface accent per screen.
Don't hide generated names, descriptions, or tags from user review.
